gates.detail: host-owned skill, its extra files and host source survive install, update and uninstall
a host-edited skill is kept, the new version lands as .dromflow-new, and the run says so
a managed skill that matches its baseline is still updated — the policy preserves, it does not freeze
an untouched install produces no .dromflow-new files
uninstall keeps skills the host edited, reports them, and still removes untouched ones
a third-party skill installs into the host, carries its licence, is recorded with its SPDX id, and survives a drom-flow update
